name: Reckoning-Spire
geological_features: Towering natural stone pillars reaching kilometers in height
specific_features: Each stone pillar emits a unique low-frequency vibration detectable by seismic equipment
description: Reckoning-Spire is a rocky world defined by its vertical landscape, where natural stone pillars rise to improbable heights supported by the low gravity and the structural integrity of the mineral-rich rock. Wind-carved arches connect the pillars at various elevations, creating a three-dimensional terrain that extends as much upward as outward.

The thin atmosphere carries sound as a deep, resonant hum generated by wind passing through the pillar forest, each column vibrating at its own frequency. The combined effect is a planetary chord that shifts with the weather, sometimes harmonious, sometimes discordant, but always present like the breathing of the world itself.

Microbial colonies living within the porous stone have been shown to respond to the vibrations, their metabolic rates fluctuating in sympathy with the harmonic patterns. Some researchers believe the organisms and the geology have co-evolved into a single system, with the microbes strengthening the stone that produces the vibrations that sustain them.

The helium-3 deposits trapped in the planet's upper strata represent a significant fuel resource, but extraction would require destroying pillar formations and potentially disrupting the harmonic ecosystem. The ethical calculus of this decision has become a test case for resource extraction policy across the sector, a reckoning between economic need and ecological conscience.
